title: FacadeParts
description: What is bolted to one building, in ITS OWN frame: origin in the middle of its footprint, on the ground. Add the building's position and turn each part to the way it faces.

name.description: What the place is called, and what its cartel says. Null where a place has no sign (a house).

shape.description: How it stands: slab, setback, stepped, shoulder or tower.

tiers.description: The solid masses it is stacked from, ground one first. The ground tier always fills the plot; the ones above step back off it.

bands.description: The ledge round each step and the parapet capping the top.

style.description: The look this building wears, drawn once from its seed so everything on it agrees.

door.description: What the front door is, for whoever builds it. Null on a building with no way in.

colour.description: A CSS colour: what this place burns over its door.

position.description: Middle of the part, in the building's frame.

size.description: [across the wall, up, out from the wall] in metres.

facing.description: Radians. Turn the part by this and its front points out of the wall it is on.

style.description: window: square, tall, ribbon, bay or grid. balcony: slab, cage, french or corner.

rail.description: balcony: how high the rail round it stands.

floor.description: balcony: false is a rail on the wall with nothing to stand on.

bars.description: balcony: a cage, with bars over the parapet.

lit.description: window: whether the light behind it is on.

blind.description: window: whether a blind is pulled down over it.

colour.description: awning, sign, window, advert: a CSS colour.

text.description: sign, advert: what it says, or null on a panel with no words.

graphic.description: advert: a lit composition instead of words - bars, rings, wave, grid or figure.

holo.description: advert: projected into the air in front of the panel.

portrait.description: advert: running up the building rather than across it.

orientation.description: sign: flat against the wall, or out at right angles so it reads down the street.

mount.description: sign: how it is hung - on the fascia, out at right angles, on the parapet, or clear of the wall on arms.
